required: Original sky-reference exposures linked by acquisition log to the 2020-08-18 sequence
Reference pointing and observation times, verified against the original frames
Optical train and passband record plus exposure, temperature, gain and calibration provenance

independentSeriesDesign.scope: If the original co-observations cannot be recovered, freeze an independent experiment with genuinely paired science and reference pointings. Preserve dark/flat calibration and record optical configuration. Predefine bracketed sky visits, intended sky-free references, spatial controls, all refusal conditions and independent validation units before acquisition.
defensibleResiduals: Reference path and absolute sky transfer must be identifiable
Reference and science scenes may contain real emission which needs an independent bound
Capture timing and exposure settings must support an uncertainty model for transfer, including correlated errors
Assess both aperture flux and shape at the fixed 5% diagnostic tolerance; retain insufficient support and any refusals

priorAnchorBudget.scope: Worst-case independent per-anchor box model, nominal six distributed positions, plane and one synthetic 2 ADU profile only. It is not an observed accuracy or an acceptance threshold for all acquisitions.
